intro:
Discover the science hiding in everyday life!
Answer quick 4-choice quiz questions
100 wonders for kids and adults
description:
Enjoy a 4-choice quiz game based on the science found in everyday life.

From bubbles in fizzy drinks and photosynthesis in plants to pencil cores and metals used in wires, each question is inspired by familiar things you may see around you.
With 100 questions included, you can check your knowledge at your own pace.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question and look at the illustration
・Choose the answer from 4 options
・Try to clear all 100 questions

Simple controls make it easy for children, adults, and families to enjoy.
Play alone for a quick knowledge check, or discuss the answers with family and friends.

Discover the small science wonders hidden all around you!
